新华社北京10月23日电 国务院办公厅日前印发《关于适应人工智能技术发展助力构: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, October 23 — The State Council General Office recently issued the "Opinion on Adapting to the Development of Artificial Intelligence Technology to Help Build an Employment-Friendly Development Model" (hereinafter referred to as the "Opinion"), deploying related work
《意见》强调，要坚持以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，深入贯彻党的二十大: The "Opinion" emphasizes that we must adhere to Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as our guide, thoroughly implement the spirit of the Party's 20th National Congress and successive plenary sessions of the 20th Central Committee, uphold the people-centered development philosophy, combine investment in material assets and investment in people closely, coordinate development and security, prioritize employment, seize the opportunity of AI empowering high-quality development, target adapting technological advancement to promote high-quality and full employment, orient toward building an employment-friendly development model, actively enhance the positive effects of artificial intelligence in creating employment opportunities, enabling traditional positions, improving employment quality, and stimulating entrepreneurial vitality, effectively mitigate the employment displacement impact of AI applications, and strive to achieve inclusive development where technological progress, industrial upgrading, employment promotion, and livelihood improvement are coordinated
一是强化人工智能的就业创造效应: First, strengthen the employment-creation effect of artificial intelligence
拓展新兴领域人工智能就业新空间，培育中小微企业稳岗扩岗新动能，创造人工智能领域就: Expand new employment opportunities for AI in emerging fields, cultivate new momentum for job retention and expansion in small and medium enterprises, create new employment and entrepreneurship models in the AI field, accelerate development of new occupations in the AI field
二是构建就业友好型人工智能升级路径: Second, build an employment-friendly AI upgrading pathway
挖掘传统领域人工智能就业潜能，减缓人工智能应用就业替代影响，建立人工智能应用就业: Tap employment potential of AI in traditional fields, mitigate employment displacement impact of AI applications, establish risk assessment mechanisms for AI application employment
协同培养人工智能创新型人才，实施人工智能专项培训计划: Jointly cultivate innovative AI talents, implement AI specialized training programs
四是推动人工智能赋能高品质就业政策服务: Fourth, promote AI empowerment of high-quality employment policy services
运用人工智能助力就业政策落实，提高就业服务智能化水平，加大转型转岗就业支持力度: Leverage AI to assist in implementation of employment policies, enhance the intelligence level of employment services, increase support for transition and job-switching employment
优化适应人机协同的劳动者权益保障制度，完善灵活就业、新就业形态劳动者社会保障制度: Optimize labor rights and interests protection systems adapted to human-machine collaboration, improve social security systems for flexible employment and new forms of employment, strengthen income distribution mechanisms adapted to AI technology development
六是完善人工智能应用就业监测预警和风险应对体系: Sixth, improve the system for monitoring, early warning, and risk response for AI application employment
强化人工智能应用就业风险监测预警，加强人工智能应用就业影响研究，健全人工智能应用: Strengthen monitoring and early warning of employment risks from AI applications, strengthen research on employment impacts of AI applications, improve risk response mechanisms for AI application employment
《意见》要求，坚持把党的领导贯彻到适应人工智能技术发展促进就业创业工作全过程各方: The "Opinion" requires that we persist in implementing Party leadership throughout the entire process and all aspects of work adapting to AI technology development to promote employment and entrepreneurship
各地区各有关部门要结合实际抓好本意见贯彻落实，进一步强化就业优先政策导向，统筹考: All regions and relevant departments must earnestly implement this Opinion in light of actual conditions, further strengthen the employment-first policy orientation, holistically consider the employment impact of AI applications, and accelerate the construction of an employment-friendly development model
